findings.note: SB 1098, early ballot drop off; identification: would have required voters dropping off early ballots to show ID. Governor's veto letter, dated May 12, 2025, says: 'Today, I vetoed Senate Bill 1098. This bill is Detrimental, Ineffective, Nonsensical, and Objectionable.'
